# The fireside recordings
The recordings in this folder come from Moodist (github.com/remvze/moodist, MIT licence for its code). Moodist's sounds
are released under the Pixabay Content License or CC0, which allow use in an app without credit. They are named here
anyway. Each was cut to a loop, its end faded into its start so it repeats without a seam, turned to mono, brought to
one loudness and encoded as Opus at 40 kbps (v6.59).

| File | From Moodist |
|---|---|
| fire.ogg | nature/campfire |
| rain.ogg | rain/rain-on-window |
| storm.ogg | rain/thunder |
| heavyrain.ogg | rain/heavy-rain |
| wind.ogg | nature/howling-wind |
| cafe.ogg | places/cafe |
| library.ogg | places/library |
| clock.ogg | things/clock |
| pages.ogg | things/paper |
| crickets.ogg | animals/crickets |
| kettle.ogg | things/boiling-water |

## The pieces (v6.60)
pieces.ogg holds short clips, one after another, that the board plays when a pawn, knight, bishop or rook moves or
captures (the queen's and the king's voices are made in the page). From Kenney's RPG Audio (kenney.nl, CC0 1.0):
drawKnife1–2, knifeSlice, knifeSlice2, metalPot1/3, footstep00/03/05, chop, doorClose_1/4 (v6.61: the creak and cloth clips taken out).
From Moodist: animals/horse-gallop (the knight's hooves, four clip-clops). Each clip brought to one peak level.
